parts.text: This question is about zinc and compounds of zinc.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Zinc is held together by electrostatic forces of attraction between particles.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Zinc is present in alloys such as brass.

ms.label: 3(b)(i)
ms.text: a mixture of a metal with other elements

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Zinc sulfate crystals are made by the reaction between zinc carbonate and dilute sulfuric acid, using the following steps. step 1 An excess of powdered zinc carbonate is added to dilute sulfuric acid. step 2 Excess zinc carbonate is separated from aqueous zinc sulfate by filtration. step 3 Aqueous zinc sulfate is heated until a saturated solution is formed. step 4 The saturated solution is allowed to cool and crystallise. step 5 The crystals are removed and dried.

ms.label: 3(c)(i)
ms.text:
M1 solid stops dissolving / disappearing
M2 no more bubbles / fizzing / effervescence on addition of solid

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Name a compound, other than zinc carbonate, that can be added to dilute sulfuric acid to produce aqueous zinc sulfate in step 1. ..................................................................................................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(c)(iv)
ms.text:
M1 (a solution containing the) maximum concentration of a solute dissolved in the solvent
M2 at a specified temperature

ms.text:
